messages:
Alex: Quick check — I need to run a midnight smoke against the inference pool. Can someone confirm we have +2 A100s available in us-west2 for the 00:30 window?
Maria: I can check quotas now, but are these reserved or ephemeral burst?
Alex: Prefer reserved if possible, but ephemeral is OK if we can lock for ~45m. The smoke will hammer small batches only.
Ben: I don't see any active reservation named 'smoke-night' in the infra dashboard. Might be a transient carve.
Lisa: @Maria I opened a procurement ticket earlier (REQ-4321) for a short borrow. It shows "pending vendor confirmation".
Maria: Running quick cloud query: `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=us-west2-* --format="table(name,zone,available)"` — will post results in 30s.
sre-bot: new incident template applied for test-runner - ID itest/1768604444
Maria: Output summary: us-west2-a: 3 available A100v4, us-west2-b: 0, us-west2-c: 1. Totals: 4 in region but 1 is flagged for another booking at 01:00.
Alex: Great — so usable pool is 3 if we avoid the 01:00 one. Can vendor_ops confirm they can convert 2 of the free ones to a short reservation?
vendor_ops: We can hold 2 nodes for a 45m window starting 00:30 PT. Need a quick confirmation from finance to accept temporary charge (estimated cost ~$120/hr).
Ben: Finance already pre-approved up to $200/hr for demo windows as per Slack thread last week. @Maria can you confirm tagging and billing center?
Maria: Tagging: `team:eng`, `project:smoke-night`, `cost-center:demo`. I'll create the reservation now (terraform snippet below).
Maria: ```hcl
resource "google_compute_reservation" "smoke_night" {
  name = "smoke-night-00-30"
  zone = "us-west2-a"
  specific_reservation_instance_properties {
    guest_accelerator  {
      type  = "nvidia-tesla-a100"
      count = 2
    }
  }
  count = 2
}
```
Lisa: Nice — can you mark the reservation with `ephemeral:true` in the ticket so ops can release after 45m?
Maria: Yep will add release script to ticket: `gcloud compute reservations delete smoke-night-00-30 --zone=us-west2-a` (scheduled via cron at 01:15 PT)
Alex: Perfect. Ben — can you run the smoke runner at 00:30 and share outputs here? Keep it to 5-minute sample.
Ben: Will do. Quick note: if the region drops below 2 free nodes we should fallback to us-east1 with lower perf. I'll add a small routing override in the test harness.
vendor_ops: Reservation confirmed and charged under temp billing. ETA hold window set. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks all — I'll post the test checklist and expected metrics shortly.
Lisa: Thx. Please ping if the 01:00 booking collides.
Ben: If anything goes sideways, paging oncall (Ben) — i'll be awake. :coffee:
Maria: Reservation created and ticket updated: REQ-4321 -> moved to "confirmed".
Alex: Closing loop — see you in the 00:25 preflight channel.
